spec.name: Halloween Festival Cauldron
spec.description: A giant stepped-round black iron cauldron on three feet, with an open heavy rim, orange and purple glowing brew, and a crooked copper ladle. Axis-aligned editable cuboids, transparent negative space, and original Halloween detailing. All geometry fits within 0–32; feet rest at y=0.

prompt: Giant round black iron witches cauldron, orange and purple glowing brew, crooked copper ladle, three feet. Cuboids, inside 0..32 all axes, base y=0, open rim and liquid visible. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
